g.text: Which one you need depends on a single question: does the Spring Boot BOM manage this version?
3.18.0 - already the fixed version, and overruled
suggest a version. It forces every version the
BOM manages, which beats a constraint outright.
override the BOM's own property - the only lever it honours
BOM declares. Everything else is ordinary Gradle
resolution, so a constraint is enough.
And both live in the ROOT subprojects block, never in backend/.
The SBOM Dependency-Track reads is produced by the root cyclonedxBom task, which spans both
modules. Fix backend alone and software-factory stays on the vulnerable version - so the finding
survives, now listing both. That is exactly what opentelemetry-api did before this change.
